definitions.gloss: daruma otoshi; traditional block-knocking toy game
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese toy consisting of a stack of colored wooden blocks topped by a daruma figure. Players knock out the blocks one at a time with a small hammer without letting the daruma fall.

examples.japanese: だるま{落|お}とし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
だるま{落|お}とし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}さ→正確さ：19774_seikakusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Daruma otoshi takes both strength and precision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧だるま{落|お}とし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I often played daruma otoshi at New Year's.

notes:
A classic wooden toy game. The player uses a small mallet ({小|こ}づち) to knock out each block in turn while keeping the tower and the daruma on top upright.
